title: SEBI Market Infrastructure — SWP/STP in Demat & ETF Dynamic Price Bands
summary: SEBI proposed allowing standing instructions for Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP) and Systematic Transfer Plans (STP) for demat mutual fund units.

blocks.content: **Overview**: SEBI proposed allowing standing instructions for Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP) and Systematic Transfer Plans (STP) for demat mutual fund units.

items: **SEBI proposal for SWP and STP in demat mutual funds** (Page 7): SEBI proposed allowing standing instructions for Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP) and Systematic Transfer Plans (STP) for demat mutual fund units.

**SEBI eases SGF rules for commodity derivatives clearing houses** (Page 7): SEBI proposed reducing Z-score for historical stress testing in commodity derivatives from 10 to 5, revising Core Settlement Guarantee Fund coverage to top 3 defaults.

**SEBI floats proposal to revamp ETF price band framework** (Page 14): SEBI proposed shifting ETF base price from T-2 closing NAV to T-1 data/iNAV with dynamic price bands (10-20% equity/debt, 6-20% gold/silver, 5% overnight).

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Capital Market Infrastructure & Operations. Demat mutual fund standing instructions and dynamic ETF bands.
